epicSummary: Automated Build Environment Setup and Configuration
epicDescription: This epic enables developers to start building projects immediately upon cloning the repository by automating the setup and management of build tools. It eliminates manual configuration steps and ensures every developer uses consistent build tooling, regardless of their local environment. The system automatically handles tool provisioning and secure access to necessary resources.

frontend.functional_requirements: Provide a user interface for developers to monitor build environment setup progress, view build tool status, and access build configuration details. Enable visualization of build environment health and troubleshooting information.
frontend.technical_requirements: Implement using React 18 with TypeScript for type safety. Use Material-UI or Ant Design for consistent UI components. Integrate with WebSocket connections for real-time build status updates. Ensure responsive design for desktop and mobile access. Implement error boundary components for graceful error handling.
frontend.devops_requirements: Set up automated CI/CD pipeline for frontend deployment using GitHub Actions. Containerize the frontend application with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes cluster. Configure Nginx as reverse proxy with SSL termination. Implement monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana for frontend performance metrics. Set up automated testing pipeline with Jest and Cypress.

stories.description: Create a dashboard interface that displays the current status of build environment setup, including tool installation progress, configuration validation, and error reporting.
Implement WebSocket integration to provide real-time updates on build environment setup progress and display live logs during the automated configuration process.

backend.functional_requirements: Provide APIs for automated build tool detection, provisioning, and configuration. Handle secure authentication for private repository access. Manage build environment state and provide health check endpoints. Support rollback mechanisms for failed configurations.
backend.technical_requirements: Develop services using Spring Boot with Java 17. Implement Maven Wrapper functionality for automated Maven setup. Use PostgreSQL for storing build configuration state and audit logs. Implement Redis caching for build tool metadata. Secure API endpoints with JWT authentication. Include comprehensive logging with structured JSON format.
backend.devops_requirements: Automate backend service deployment with GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Containerize services with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes using Helm charts. Set up Prometheus monitoring with custom metrics for build success rates and setup times. Configure Grafana dashboards for operational visibility. Implement automated backup strategies for configuration data.

stories.description: Enhance the existing MavenWrapperDownloader to support automatic detection of Maven requirements and secure download with authentication support for private repositories.
Create REST API endpoints for managing build environment configurations, including tool version management, dependency resolution, and environment validation.
Implement secure credential management for accessing private repositories during build setup, including support for SSH keys, personal access tokens, and OAuth authentication.
Develop service to automatically detect, download, and configure specific versions of build tools (Maven, Gradle, Node.js) based on project requirements and team standards.
Create comprehensive health check endpoints that validate build environment setup, tool availability, and configuration correctness with detailed diagnostic information.
Implement rollback functionality to restore previous working build environment configurations in case of setup failures or incompatible tool versions.
